skills.description: Using fixed cameras in a smart greenhouse to analyze plant morphology in real time (e.g., leaf wilting angle, stem uprightness, leaf color changes) combined with environmental sensors (light intensity, temperature, humidity, soil moisture), an AI decision model outputs climate control commands including irrigation (pump/solenoid valve), shade-net opening, fan/wet-curtain on-off, heater on-off, etc. This skill implements closed-loop control driven by plant demand, improving resource efficiency and crop yield.
